releaseNotes: Milkyway Studio v0.5.8 — multi-tool platform launcher.
CrimeFactory is now a tool module behind /tools/crimefactory.
Tool registry pattern: add a new tool by appending one entry to TOOL_REGISTRY.
Migration 0013: tool_type column scopes projects per tool; CrimeFactory screens filter exclusively.
Startup routing: Milkyway home shown by default; "Open CrimeFactory directly" toggle bypasses it.
Portable EXE renamed from CrimeFactory-Studio-Portable-* to Milkyway-Studio-Portable-*.
appId and %APPDATA%\CrimeFactory Studio data folder unchanged — zero data migration required.
